publicRead.authorizationBoundary: Only an admitted archive that passes current runtime qualification is readable; the lowercase SHA-256 URL is an unguessable content address, not an account or battle secret.

all: stored row hash equals path hash
exact bytes hash equals path hash
archive bytes at or below the server archive limit
no authoring evidence or preview members

contentSourcesMapping: For a contentSources entry with package identity and archiveSha256, select the route by sourceKind and substitute archiveSha256. contentSha256 and assetRefs are identity/closure metadata, not alternate byte URLs. Missing package identity has no URL and must retain the normal presentation fallback.
versionCoexistence: All admitted, currently runtime-qualified archives remain addressable by their own archiveSha256 without requiring the current active release. A later release must not rewrite an existing archive identity.
clientResponsibilities: Keep development and production cache roots separate.
Download to a temporary file, verify the whole archive SHA-256, then atomically publish into the selected cache root.
Use archiveSha256 rather than object name or package version as the cache key.
Treat download, transport, archive, digest, capability, or cache failure as presentation-only degradation; never pause, alter, or infer Worker combat, rewards, hits, or results.
outOfScope: client cache implementation, eviction, quota, timeout, or retry policy
